crush.r1_d: You like this person, that's a fact, but your life carries on exactly the same: you don't think about them at night, their absence does nothing to you, and their stories scroll by with the rest. It's nice, it adds a bit of spice to the week, and it stops there.
crush.r1_a: Enjoy it without overthinking. If it's meant to become more, you'll feel it without needing a test.
crush.r2_d: The physical signs are there: the stomach, the cheeks, the heart speeding up when their name shows on your screen. The attachment, though, is still light. This is the phase where everything is exciting precisely because nothing is settled yet.
crush.r2_a: No rush. A crush at this stage feeds on small moments: look for chances to talk, not for grand declarations.
crush.r3_t: A real crush, firmly settled in
crush.r3_d: You're past the butterflies stage. You think about this person every day, you adjust your routes and your outfits, your friends know. It's no longer a detail of your week, it's one of its main threads.
crush.r3_a: This is the right moment to test the waters, because a crush like this doesn't switch off by itself: it grows or it eats at you. One real one-on-one conversation will tell you more than three months of clues.
crush.r4_d: The jealousy that stings, missing them when they're not around, other people not interesting you anymore: these are no longer signs of excitement, they're signs of attachment. What you feel doesn't just exist anymore, it matters.
crush.r4_a: Be honest with yourself: you're no longer wondering whether you like this person, you're hoping it's mutual. That's the question to deal with now.
crush.r5_d: You know their flaws and it changes nothing. You feel in the right place with this person, you keep what they tell you, you picture bits of the future. This is no longer the thrill of a crush, it's deep attachment: feelings of love, or as good as.
crush.r5_a: The only question left is what the other person feels, and no test can answer that for you. Keep one thing in mind: with feelings at this level, doing nothing hurts more, in the long run, than a no.
